claim: Prompt filtering, which samples training prompts from both solvable and unsolvable partitions, prevents policy collapse and stabilizes training, leading to higher accuracy compared to training without filtering.
falsifier: Train an on-device LLM with and without prompt filtering under identical conditions, measure accuracy and offloading ratio, and verify that filtering yields higher and more stable accuracy.

conditions: training uses a hierarchical reward that penalizes cloud-assisted correct answers
cloud LLM usage is capped at a maximum call-for-help ratio
the on-device model is updated via a group-adaptive policy gradient algorithm
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the reported models, reasoning tasks, and training setup; transfer to other settings is unestablished.

title: Prompt filtering that ensures for testing accuracy and training
